_description: Historical rolling mode (Trinity-style): one simulation run per valid start year in HISTORICAL_RETURNS. Tests that returnModel='historical_rolling' overrides numSimulations and runs (HISTORICAL_YEARS - horizon + 1) separate runs, each walking the series from a different start year.
_rationale: 10-year horizon (currentAge=60, lifeExpectancy=69) gives numRuns = 97 - 10 + 1 = 88 valid start years (1928-1937 through 2015-2024). Pure accumulation: $500k Roth, no spending, no income, no inflation — every run grows monotonically by its own slice of history. probability=100 because zero spending cannot deplete the balance. Median final balance is the 44th-ranked outcome and lands well within the historical 60/40 10-year experience.
name: Historical Rolling 10yr
